title: Measure remaining pkgs/id test runtime targets after nextest
body: Measure the remaining #6378 test-time targets on remote Fleet runners and route any missed target into a scoped follow-up. Do not remove or weaken tests.

payload.problem: After #8032 adopted cargo-nextest, #6378 was closed without measuring all of its remaining runtime targets. Measure current-main unit, integration, E2E, NixOS VM and CI legs on remote Fleet runners, compare against the original thresholds, and route every missed target to a scoped live follow-up.
payload.priority_reason: Normal-priority performance investigation; the nextest slice landed, but the previous issue has unmeasured acceptance criteria and no current follow-up tracker.
evidence: #6378 issue body sets unit <2m, integration <5m, E2E <10m, VM and CI optimization criteria.
PR #8032 recorded 3468 cargo nextest lib tests in 132s with a stub web/dist; it did not measure integration, E2E or VM legs.
#6378 triage note #6737334164 says VM-test optimization and selective-by-path execution were left as later slices.
Search of current issues found no separate follow-up for those remaining criteria.
acceptance: Remote current-main run evidence records exact command, SHA, handle/URL, elapsed time and result for unit, integration, E2E, NixOS VM and CI legs; each unavailable leg records the exact blocker.
Results are compared against #6378 thresholds and separate build/setup time from test execution time.
Each missed target gets a scoped implementation issue with a runnable done check and a live queue task, or evidence shows all targets are met.
No test coverage is removed or weakened to improve timing.
tests: Measure all available test classes via Fleet remote dispatch; verify test suites remain enabled and compare timing results to the stated thresholds.

issue.title: [Performance] Measure remaining pkgs/id test runtime targets after nextest

include: pkgs/id test recipes and current test target partitioning
CI test steps and NixOS VM test legs
remote run timing, coverage and follow-up routing
exclude: running suites on laptop or sandbox
bundling multiple implementation optimizations into this measurement pass

dedupe.basis: Searched developing-today/code issues for #6378 test execution time, nextest, NixOS VM test optimization and selective-by-file execution; no existing open follow-up matched the remaining acceptance criteria.
